5469-joshua-volume-3.title: Joshua Volume 3
5469-joshua-volume-3.creator: Georg Ebers
5469-joshua-volume-3.description: A book by Georg Ebers. The fear that the man she loved was walking in mistaken paths, and the startling act of Hur had made the towering waves of her passion subside and her mind, now capable of calmer reflection, desired first of all to know what had so long detained him whom she had summoned in the name of her God, and why he came alone, without Ephraim.

arxiv-1802-07468.title: Quantum Decoherence in System-Bath Interferometry
arxiv-1802-07468.creator: Ali Soltanmanesh, Afshin Shafiee
arxiv-1802-07468.description: Abstract In this paper, we study a quantum harmonic oscillator in a Mach-Zehnder-type interferometer which interacts with an environment, including electromagnetic oscillators. By solving the Lindblad master equation, we calculate the resulted interference pattern of the system. Interestingly, we show that even if one considers the decoherence effect, the system will keep some of its quantum properties.

arxiv-2104-09688.title: Searches for new physics at SND@LHC
arxiv-2104-09688.creator: Alexey Boyarsky, Oleksii Mikulenko, Maksym Ovchynnikov, and Lesya Shchutska
arxiv-2104-09688.description: Abstract SND@LHC is an approved experiment equipped to detect scatterings of neutrinos produced in the far-forward direction at the LHC, and aimed to measure their properties. In addition, the detector has a potential to search for new feebly interacting particles (FIPs) that may be produced in proton-proton collisions.

arxiv-2106-07091.title: On-Off Center-Surround Receptive Fields for Accurate and Robust Image Classification
arxiv-2106-07091.creator: Zahra Babaiee, Ramin Hasani, Mathias Lechner, Daniela Rus, Radu Grosu
arxiv-2106-07091.description: Abstract Robustness to variations in lighting conditions is a key objective for any deep vision system. To this end, our paper extends the receptive field of convolutional neural networks with two residual components, ubiquitous in the visual processing system of vertebrates: On-center and off-center pathways, with excitatory center and inhibitory surround; OOCS for short.

arxiv-2106-08498.title: Modeling of the refractive index profile of a femtosecond written waveguide in LiNbO 3
arxiv-2106-08498.creator: Damián A. Presti, Valentín Guarepi, Fabián Videla, Gustavo A. Torchia
arxiv-2106-08498.description: Abstract Femtosecond laser pulse systems allows to modify in a precise and permanent way the optical properties of a transparent materials. This process enables the direct writing of guiding structures in materials, commonly known as waveguides, which are the base for optical circuit fabrication.

arxiv-2107-09575.title: Optical Shock-Enhanced Self-Photon Acceleration Preprint: OSESPA ARXIV
arxiv-2107-09575.creator: P. Franke, D. Ramsey, T. T. Simpson, D. H. Froula, J. P. Palastro
arxiv-2107-09575.description: Abstract Photon accelerators can spectrally broaden laser pulses with high efficiency in moving electron density gradients driven in a rapidly ionizing plasma. When driven by a conventional laser pulse, the group velocity walk-off experienced by the accelerated photons and deterioration of the gradient from diffraction and plasma-refraction limit the extent of spectral broadening.

arxiv-2108-07141.title: Hurdles for Developers in Cryptography
arxiv-2108-07141.creator: Mohammadreza Hazhirpasand, Oscar Nierstrasz, Mohammadhossein Shabani, Mohammad Ghafari
arxiv-2108-07141.description: Abstract Prior research has shown that cryptography is hard to use for developers. We aim to understand what cryptography issues developers face in practice. We clustered 91 954 cryptography-related questions on the Stack Overflow website, and manually analyzed a significant sample ( i.e., 383) of the questions to comprehend the crypto challenges developers commonly face in this domain.

arxiv-2209-04137.title: Machine Learning-based Selection of Graph Partitioning Strategy Using the Characteristics of Graph Data and Algorithm (Regular Papers)
arxiv-2209-04137.creator: YoungJoon Park Department of Electrical & Computer Engineering Seoul National University Seoul, South Korea dudwns930@snu.ac.kr, DongKyu Lee Department of Electrical & Computer Engineering Seoul National University Seoul, South Korea ardor12@snu.ac.kr, Tien-Cuong Bui Department of Electrical & Compu
arxiv-2209-04137.description: Abstract Analyzing large graph data is an essential part of many modern applications, such as social networks. Due to its large computational complexity, distributed processing is frequently employed. This requires graph data to be divided across nodes, and the choice of partitioning strategy has a great impact on the execution time of the task.

arxiv-2303-10287.title: Non-Steepness and Maximum Likelihood Estimation Properties of the Truncated Multivariate Normal Distributions
arxiv-2303-10287.creator: Michael Levine, Donald Richards, Jianxi Su
arxiv-2303-10287.description: Abstract This article considers exponential families of truncated multivariate normal distributions with one-sided truncation for some or all coordinates. We observe that if all components are one-sided truncated then this family is not full. The family of truncated multivariate normal distributions is extended to a full family, and the extended family is investigated in detail.

arxiv-2303-11015.title: Comparison of Non-deterministic Linear Systems by (γ,δ)-Similarity
arxiv-2303-11015.creator: Armin Pirastehzad, Arjan van der Schaft, , and Bart Besselink
arxiv-2303-11015.description: Abstract We introduce (γ,δ)-similarity, a notion of system comparison that measures to what extent two stable linear dynamical systems behave similarly in an input-output sense. This behavioral similarity is characterized by measuring the sensitivity of the difference between the two output trajectories in terms of the external inputs to the two potentially non-deterministic systems.

arxiv-2304-06845.title: SemEval-2023 Task 12: Sentiment Analysis for African Languages (AfriSenti-SemEval)
arxiv-2304-06845.creator: Shamsuddeen Hassan Muhammad, Idris Abdulmumin, Seid Muhie Yimam, David Ifeoluwa Adelani, Ibrahim Sa’id Ahmad, Nedjma Ousidhoum, Abinew Ayele, Saif M. Mohammad, Meriem Beloucif, Sebastian Ruder
arxiv-2304-06845.description: Abstract We present the first Africentric SemEval Shared task, Sentiment Analysis for African Languages (AfriSenti-SemEval) 1 1 1 The dataset is available at https://github.com/afrisenti-semeval/afrisent-semeval-2023 . . AfriSenti-SemEval is a sentiment classification challenge in 14 African languages (Amharic, Algerian Arabic, Hausa, Igbo, Kinyarwanda, Moroccan Arabic, Mozambican Portuguese, Nigerian Pidgin, Oromo, Swahili, Tigrinya, Twi, Xitsonga, and Yorùbá) Muhammad et al.

arxiv-2307-16058.title: Generalized Bell scenarios: disturbing consequences on local-hidden-variable models
arxiv-2307-16058.creator: André Mazzari, Gabriel Ruffolo, Carlos Vieira, Tassius Temistocles, Rafael Rabelo, Marcelo Terra Cunha *
arxiv-2307-16058.description: Abstract Bell nonlocality and Kochen-Specker contextuality are among the main topics of foundations of quantum theory. Both of them are related to stronger-than-classical correlations, with the former usually referring to spatially separated systems while the latter considering a single system. In recent works, a unified framework for these phenomena was presented.

arxiv-2308-03576.title: Structural properties of epitaxial α \alpha -U thin films on Ti, Zr, W and Nb
arxiv-2308-03576.creator: R. Nicholls, D. A. Chaney, G. H. Lander, R. Springell, C. Bell
arxiv-2308-03576.description: Abstract Thin layers of orthorhombic uranium ( α \alpha -U) have been grown onto buffered sapphire substrates by d . c . magnetron sputtering, resulting in the discovery of new epitaxial matches to Ti(00.1) and Zr(00.1) surfaces. These systems have been characterised by X-ray diffraction and reflectivity and the optimal deposition temperatures have been determined.

arxiv-2411-19475.title: GalaxAlign: Mimicking Citizen Scientists’ Multimodal Guidance for Galaxy Morphology Analysis
arxiv-2411-19475.creator: Ruoqi Wang, Haitao Wang, Qiong Luo
arxiv-2411-19475.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ruoqi Wang, Haitao Wang, Qiong Luo. Galaxy morphology analysis involves studying galaxies based on their shapes and structures. For such studies, fundamental tasks include identifying and classifying galaxies in astronomical images, as well as retrieving visually or structurally similar galaxies through similarity search. Existing methods either directly train domain-specific foundation models on large, annotated datasets or fine-tune vision foundation models on a smaller set of images. The former is effective but costly, while the latter is more resource-efficient but often yields lower accuracy.

arxiv-2501-18562.title: CGAN-Based Framework for Meson Mass and Width Prediction
arxiv-2501-18562.creator: S. Rostami M. Malekhosseini, M. Rahavi Ezabadi, K. Azizi
arxiv-2501-18562.description: Abstract Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) are influential machine learning models that have gained prominence across various research fields, including high-energy physics (HEP) simulations. Among them, Conditional GANs (CGANs) offer a unique advantage by conditioning on specific parameters, making them particularly well-suited for meson studies.

arxiv-2511-04968.title: Scalar Resonances near 650 and 95 GeV in the GNMSSM with Correct Dark Matter Relic Abundance
arxiv-2511-04968.creator: Jingwei Lian, Yao-Bei Liu
arxiv-2511-04968.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jingwei Lian, Yao-Bei Liu. Recent CMS analyses report an excess in the diphoton-plus- b ​ b ¯ b\bar{b} channel, indicative of a heavy resonance around 650 GeV decaying into a Standard Model (SM)-like Higgs boson and a lighter scalar near 95 GeV. The case for a 95 GeV state is further supported by diphoton excesses observed by both CMS and ATLAS, as well as a b ​ b ¯ b\bar{b} excess previously observed at the Large Electron-Position collider.

pmc-10696737.title: A metabolomics study in aqueous humor discloses altered arginine metabolism in Parkinson’s disease
pmc-10696737.creator: Joan Serrano-Marín, Silvia Marin, David Bernal-Casas, Alejandro Lillo, Marc González-Subías, Gemma Navarro, Marta Cascante, Juan Sánchez-Navés, Rafael Franco
pmc-10696737.description: BackgroundThe lack of accessible and informative biomarkers results in a delayed diagnosis of Parkinson’s disease (PD), whose symptoms appear when a significant number of dopaminergic neurons have already disappeared. The retina, a historically overlooked part of the central nervous system (CNS), has gained recent attention.

pmc-11520848.title: High-flow nasal cannula oxygen therapy versus noninvasive ventilation for elderly chronic obstructive pulmonary disease patients after extubation: a noninferior randomized controlled trial protocol
pmc-11520848.creator: Xinyuan Yang, Jiangli Cheng, Zhen Wang, Meiling Dong, Zhaomin Xu, He Yu, Guopeng Liang
pmc-11520848.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionNoninvasive ventilation (NIV) is widely used for sequential extubation in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). However, NIV may cause many adverse events such as claustrophobia, facial skin compression, air leakage, bloating, and even reflux aspiration, resulting in poor patient compliance/tolerance and high failure rate, especially for older adults who are at high risk of communication difficulties and consciousness disorder.

pmc-12501095.title: Establishment of a humanized mouse model of pulmonary fibrosis for advancing drug validation strategies
pmc-12501095.creator: Md. Nakibul Hasan, Yuri Chae, Su Yeon Lee, Young Mo Kang
pmc-12501095.description: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is a progressive interstitial lung disease characterized by excessive extracellular matrix deposition and limited therapeutic options. Conventional preclinical models, such as the bleomycin (BLM)-induced lung fibrosis (BILF) model in immunocompetent mice, fail to replicate the complexity of the human immune environment and are thus unsuitable for evaluating human-specific antibody and cell therapies.

pmc-12538086.title: Multifaceted disruption of AMPA receptor signaling by CACNG8 variants: Integrated evidence from human genetics and molecular simulation
pmc-12538086.creator: Simona Alibrandi, Domenico Mordà, Concetta Scimone, Giorgia Abate, Ignacio Babiloni Chust, Carmela Rinaldi, Lucia Poggi, Sergio Zaccaria Scalinci, Rosalia D’Angelo, Antonina Sidoti, Luigi Donato
pmc-12538086.description: The Transmembrane AMPA Receptor Regulatory Protein Gamma-8 (TARP γ-8), encoded by CACNG8, regulates AMPA receptor (AMPAR) trafficking, gating, and synaptic localization. Although well-characterized in central synapses, its role in retinal development and disease remains underexplored. This study investigates CACNG8 within the context of inherited retinal dystrophies (IRDs) by integrating human genetics within silico structural analysis.

pmc-12700551.title: Nonionotropic action of an acid-sensing ion channel inhibits leukemogenesis in the acidic bone marrow niche
pmc-12700551.creator: Hao Gu, Lietao Weng, Chiqi Chen, Xiaoxin Hao, Rongkun Tao, Xin Qi, Xiaoyun Lai, Ligen Liu, Tinghua Zhang, Yiming Jiang, Jin Wang, Wei-Guang Li, Zhuo Yu, Li Xie, Yaping Zhang, Xiaoxiao He, Ye Yu, Yi Yang, Dehua Wu, Yuzheng Zhao, Tian-Le Xu, Guo-Qiang Chen, Junke Zheng
pmc-12700551.description: The metabolic microenvironment plays important roles in tumorigenesis, but how leukemia-initiating cells (LICs) response to the acidic BM niche remains largely unknown. Here, we show that acid-sensing ion channel 3 (ASIC3) dramatically delays leukemogenesis. Asic3 deletion results in a remarkably enhanced self-renewal, reduced differentiation, and 9-fold greater number of murine acute myeloid LICs.

pmc-12947765.title: Lived Experiences of Deathcare Workers in Managing Infectious Dead Bodies
pmc-12947765.creator: Nkosi Nkosi Botha, Cynthia Esinam Segbedzi, Victor Kwasi Dumahasi, Ruby Victoria Kodom, Mary Aku Ogum, Samuel Maneen, Ivy Selorm Tsedze, Lucy Adjanor Akoto, Edward Wilson Ansah
pmc-12947765.description: IntroductionDeathcare workers in resource‐limited countries are chronically exposed to infectious diseases, mainly due to a lack of effective safety controls, inadequate resources, poor training and laxity on the part of industry managers. However, there is limited evidence from these countries, and very little is known about how deathcare workers manage infectious dead bodies.

pmc-13125759.title: Exploring chromosomal position effects for predictable tuning of metabolic pathways in yeast
pmc-13125759.creator: Haosen Hong, Yuxin Cai, Jian Wang, Chang Dong, Qiang Zhang, Jiazhang Lian
pmc-13125759.description: Precise control of gene expression is essential for optimizing metabolic pathways, yet current tuning strategies based on promoter strength or gene copy number remain largely empirical. Chromosomal position represents an additional regulatory axis, as identical gene expression cassettes can exhibit markedly different expression levels depending on their integration sites.

pmc-13474497.title: Clinical features, triggers, and risk factors of severe gastrointestinal involvement in anti-NXP2-positive juvenile dermatomyositis: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-13474497.creator: Xin Yao, Wei Zhang, Xinning Wang, Ying Chi, Yuan Liu, Xiaolei Wang, Wenquan Niu, Jianguo Li
pmc-13474497.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to examine the clinical characteristics, triggers and risk factors for gastrointestinal (GI) complications in anti-NXP2-positive JDM (anti-NXP2-JDM) patients.MethodsA retrospective analysis was performed on 57 anti-NXP2-JDM patients, including 19 with severe GI complications (GI group) and 38 without GI involvement (Non-GI group).ResultsThe GI group had a male-to-female ratio of 6:13 and a mean onset age of 5.

pmc-13609749.title: The Statin Paradox: Drivers and Consequences of Therapy Discontinuation
pmc-13609749.creator: Adrianna Dylik, Mikołaj Musiał, Michał Radke, Dominika Tuzimek, Dominika Rogoża, Bartosz Czekała, Anna Wawrzyniak, Nadzeya Zhuk, Katarzyna Skrypnik, Damian Skrypnik
pmc-13609749.description: Highlights What are the main findings? Statin discontinuation is particularly frequent within the first year of therapy.Fear of side effects, misinformation, and poor doctor-patient communication are the primary drivers of statin non-adherence. What are the implications of the main findings? Unaddressed non-adherence substantially increases long-term cardiovascular risks and overall healthcare costs.

uslaw-usc-t16-s428d2.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s428d2.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 1 (National Parks, Military Parks, Monuments, And Seashores); Subchapter LX (National Military Parks). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary of the Interior is authorized to accept donations of land, interests in land, buildings, structures, and other property within a distance of one mile from the boundaries of said Fort Donelson National Battlefield, as extended.
